API_TTFT: Directly measured stream call start to first content; kept as separate field.
serial_readiness: After first request only:previous actual business end_time to current first_time. Includes intervening qualification/binding/logging as the next serial request is ready after its predecessor finishes. First request has no logged monotonic ready timestamp and is unavailable, never reconstructed.
counts_rate: Readiness-SLO available successful requests per full measured workflow wall, with missing/failed counts explicit. This is serial micro-workflow throughput, not open-arrival capacity.
